book.title: 闪电出租车，送我们去坐船！
book.subtitle: 小岛故事节的第一次航行
book.question: 第一次坐船要经过哪些步骤？

moral.zh: 不同的交通工具各有本领，遵守规则才能一起平安到达。
moral.en: Different vehicles work together; following safety rules helps everyone arrive safely.

pages.zhText: 今天，小岛要办故事节！安安把小熊放进背包，妈妈收好船票和证件。去小岛没有一路通到底的公路，她们要先坐车，再坐船。
pages.enText: Today was the island story festival! An'an packed her bear, and Mom checked their tickets. They would travel by car, then by boat.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Home packing bear and tickets, no readable text.

pages.zhText: 楼下，绿色闪电出租车已经停稳。车门上的黄色闪电亮亮的。安安从安全的一侧上车，坐进预约好的儿童座椅，妈妈帮她扣好安全带。
pages.enText: Their green Lightning Taxi waited downstairs. An'an boarded from the safe side and buckled into the child seat arranged for the trip.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Parked GREEN taxi yellow lightning door decal, rear child seat mom buckling girl.

pages.zhText: “去客运码头，不是汽车站哦。”妈妈告诉司机。安安想了想：“汽车送我们到水边，轮船再接着送！”司机笑着点点头。
pages.enText: “The passenger terminal, please,” Mom said. “The car takes us to the water, then the boat takes over!” An'an smiled.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Taxi rear cabin belted mother girl, driver front facing forward.

pages.zhText: 路口红灯亮了，出租车稳稳停下。旁边的装货区里，红色大众皮卡也准备出发，黑色货斗里的道具箱已经固定好。
pages.enText: The taxi stopped at a red light. Nearby, the red Volkswagen pickup was ready too, with prop cases secured in its black cargo bed.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Stationary green taxi at red light, red pickup in separate loading bay secured cases.

pages.zhText: 林阿姨在车旁挥挥手：“木偶戏也要去小岛！”安安隔着关好的车窗挥手回应。原来，今天大家都有同一个目的地。
pages.enText: Aunt Lin waved beside the pickup. “Our puppet show is going to the island!” An'an waved through the closed window. They shared a destination.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Girl waving through closed taxi window to Aunt Lin safely beside parked pickup.

pages.zhText: 车窗外，高楼慢慢变矮，海面露出一条蓝边。安安发现远处的大船：“快看，水上也有交通工具排队！”
pages.enText: Buildings grew lower, and a blue strip of sea appeared. “Look! Vehicles queue on the water too!” An'an spotted distant boats.
pages.illustrationPrompt: View past belted girl through taxi window toward harbor boats.

pages.zhText: 到了码头，出租车在指定落客区停好。妈妈先看清车外情况，再带安安下车。她们和司机约好返程接车地点，没有站在车道里聊天。
pages.enText: At the terminal, the taxi stopped in the drop-off bay. Mom checked outside before they got out. They agreed where to meet on their return.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Parked taxi terminal dropoff girl mom on protected pavement.

pages.zhText: “谢谢你，闪电出租车！”安安挥挥手。绿色小车留在岸上继续工作，她和妈妈沿着人行指引走进候船大厅。
pages.enText: “Thank you, Lightning Taxi!” The green car stayed ashore to keep working. An'an and Mom followed the pedestrian route into the terminal.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Wide terminal taxi departing separate lane mom girl walking protected path.

pages.zhText: 大厅里有人拖箱子，有人抱宝宝。妈妈核对目的地、船班和登船口。安安紧紧牵着妈妈：“这么多船，不能跟着别人随便走。”
pages.enText: Families filled the hall. Mom checked the destination, sailing and gate. “We must find our own boat,” An'an said, holding her hand.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Terminal hall adult checks ticket girl holds hand, pictogram signs only.

pages.zhText: 安安摸摸背包，忽然着急了：“小熊呢？”妈妈陪她停在一旁找。拉链一开，小熊正躺在水壶旁，像在等着出发。
pages.enText: “Where's Bear?” An'an worried. They stepped aside to check. Inside her bag, Bear lay beside the water bottle, ready for the trip.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Quiet waiting bench mother girl finding bear inside orange backpack.

pages.zhText: 广播通知登船了。她们排队检票，不推也不跑。安安看见蓝白色的船，船边的工作人员正指引大家走专用通道。
pages.enText: Boarding began. They queued without pushing. Beside the blue-and-white ferry, staff guided passengers along their own walkway.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Passenger boarding queue blue white ferry enclosed walkway crew, no cars near pedestrians.

pages.zhText: 登船通道有一点坡度。安安牵着妈妈，慢慢跨过接缝，另一只手扶着栏杆。“一步一步来，轮船不会因为我慢一点就生气。”
pages.enText: The gangway sloped gently. Holding Mom's hand and the rail, An'an stepped over a joint. “One careful step at a time.”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Close walking gangway handrail mom holding child hand, high safe rails.

pages.zhText: 进了客舱，妈妈把背包放稳，不挡过道。安安坐在窗边，看见远处另一条通道上，有汽车正按顺序登上车客渡船。
pages.enText: In the cabin, Mom stowed the bag clear of the aisle. Through the window, An'an saw cars boarding a vehicle ferry along a different route.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Interior blue white passenger cabin girl seated window distant vehicle ferry ramp.

pages.zhText: 船员介绍救生衣的位置和使用方法。安安认真听，记住紧急时要听指挥。她没有把救生衣当玩具，也不随便打开应急设备。
pages.enText: A crew member explained the life jackets and emergency instructions. An'an listened carefully. Safety equipment was not a toy.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Crew demonstrates orange lifejacket to seated families in bright cabin.

pages.zhText: 呜——船笛响了，岸边慢慢向后退。其实，是船离开了码头。安安把小熊抱好：“现在轮到轮船接力啦！”
pages.enText: The horn sounded, and the shore seemed to slide backward. Their boat was leaving! “Now it's the ferry's turn,” An'an told Bear.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Girl mom seated cabin watching dock recede through large window.

pages.zhText: 窗外，一艘小拖船正在帮助大船移动。还有一座浮标随着水面轻轻起伏。妈妈说：“它们各有任务，船长会按航行规则走。”
pages.enText: A tug helped a large ship nearby. A buoy bobbed on the water. “They each have a job. Captains follow navigation rules,” Mom explained.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Window view tug beside large vessel distant buoy, girl watching from inside.

pages.zhText: 遇到一点波浪，安安觉得肚子怪怪的。妈妈陪她坐稳，看向远处，并告诉船员她有些不舒服。休息一会儿，她感觉好多了。
pages.enText: Small waves made An'an feel queasy. Mom helped her sit still and look into the distance, then told the crew. After a rest, she felt better.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Calm seated girl mom supportive crew nearby inside cabin, horizon visible.

pages.zhText: 小岛越来越近，船速慢下来。安安没有急着站起来：“要等船停稳，还要等工作人员说可以下船。”小熊也乖乖坐着。
pages.enText: The island drew closer as the ferry slowed. “We wait until it is secured and the crew says to leave,” An'an said. Bear waited too.
pages.illustrationPrompt: Cabin seated family island harbor approaching outside.

pages.zhText: 上岸后，她们沿人行通道来到广场。咦，林阿姨正推着道具箱过来！远处卸货区里，红皮卡也到了。它怎么跨过水面的呢？
pages.enText: Ashore, they followed the walkway to the square. Aunt Lin arrived with the prop cases! The red pickup stood in the unloading bay. How had it crossed the water?
pages.illustrationPrompt: Island pedestrian plaza Aunt Lin handcart cases red pickup parked distant mother girl greet.

pages.zhText: 木偶狐狸探出小脑袋，故事节开始啦。安安轻轻拍手：“出租车送人到码头，轮船送我们过水面。红皮卡的坐船故事，我也想听！”
pages.enText: The fox puppet appeared, and the festival began. “The taxi took us to the dock, and the ferry brought us here. Now I want to hear the pickup's boat story!”
pages.illustrationPrompt: Island puppet stage fox puppet seated mother girl audience red pickup far unloading bay.

parentGuide.goal: 理解水陆交通接力，认识候船、登船与乘船规则。
parentGuide.reminder: 不同船型规定不同，以船方指引为准；不在真实码头模仿游戏。
questions: 出租车、皮卡和渡船各完成了什么任务？
为什么行人和车辆要走不同的通道？
parentGuide.activity: 在家用积木搭码头，用纸盒当渡船，分别画出行人和车辆路线；成人陪同，不在水边游戏。

ageTips.age4to5: 找交通工具的颜色，按顺序讲述登船过程。
ageTips.age6to8: 比较客运船和车客渡船，说明等待和分流的原因。
